rca_of_the_issue: Reported symptom was a static hero background video. Current fix appears effective in Chrome: React sets muted/defaultMuted and play(), and backend serves the Drive video from disk cache with HTTP Range support. The video is short (~5.17s), so a 3-4s currentTime comparison may wrap because loop=true; sample multiple readings or normalize currentTime to 0 when verifying motion.
